criteria.criterion: Neutral starter has no live identity/branch set, standing grant, schedule or autonomous-write permission.

deterministic_checks_required: Unknown protocol/version, malformed selectors, absent persistent source, expiry and absent native release report exact blocked/unavailable codes.
native_proof_obligations: Actual unsupported/missing runtime behavior remains a native case.
